summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Dedicated 'Boss Approvals Room' as a distinct top-level navbar room with real-time pending counters, Mobile Money SMS verification, and instant WhatsApp dispatch.
2. Strict duplicate prevention per restaurant enforcing unique phone numbers and student registration IDs with 1-click 'Top Up Existing Member' redirect.
3. Multi-tenant hybrid cafeteria cloud architecture with direct restaurant slug/code URL routing, dynamic cafeteria branding, and edge-to-cloud bidirectional sync.
